# Raphaelson & Levine Law Firm

> NYC-based personal injury law firm specializing in vehicle accidents, construction injuries, slip-and-fall cases, and premises liability with over 30 years of experience and $1B+ in verdicts and settlements.

Raphaelson & Levine serves clients across Manhattan, Brooklyn, Bronx, Queens, Long Island, and surrounding areas. The firm is known for aggressive representation in complex personal injury cases, with attorneys recognized by Best Lawyers and other tier-1 honors.
